title: Learning Continuous Patient Trajectories from Electronic Health Records
abstract: arXiv:2609.36144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electronic health records provide irregular observations of latent patient states that evolve continuously over time. Recent autoregressive models condition on clinical histories to forecast future events as sequences of discrete observations. Conversely, multi-marginal flow matching provides a continuous-time formulation, but using multiple observations to supervise training paths does not itself give the learned dynamics access to preceding patient history. We introduce EHRFlow, a multi-marginal flow-matching framework that conditions on encoded patient history, thereby allowing future dynamics to depend on the patient's prior clinical trajectory. Our proposed framework accommodates irregular observation times and supports forecasting at arbitrary horizons. translated_title: 从电子健康记录中学习连续的患者轨迹
translated_abstract: 电子健康记录提供对潜在患者状态的不规则观测，而这些状态随时间连续演化。近期的自回归模型以临床历史为条件，将未来事件预测为离散观测的序列。与之相对，多边缘流匹配提供了一种连续时间的建模方式，但仅使用多个观测来监督训练路径，并不能让学习到的动力学获取患者此前的病史信息。我们提出了 EHRFlow，这是一个以编码后的患者历史为条件的多边缘流匹配框架，从而使未来动力学能够依赖于患者先前的临床轨迹。我们所提出的框架能够适应不规则的观测时间，并支持在任意时间跨度上进行预测。在受控的合成基准测试中，EHRFlow 提升了临床编码预测和潜在状态恢复的效果。在包含超过一百万患者的真实临床数据集上……
tldr: EHRFlow 提出了一种以编码患者历史为条件的多边缘流匹配框架，可从不规则观测的电子健康记录中学习连续的患者轨迹动力学，并支持任意时间跨度的临床预测。
en_tdlr: EHRFlow is a multi-marginal flow-matching framework conditioned on encoded patient history that learns continuous patient trajectory dynamics from irregularly observed electronic health records and enables forecasting at arbitrary horizons.
